sentences.text: In short: SSS INVEST 3 AS is an established company based in Oslo, profitable in 2025.

According to the register, the registered activity of SSS INVEST 3 AS is "Investering i aksjer og andre eierandeler i andre selskaper og foretak, samt all annen virksomhet som hermed står i forbindelse.".
SSS INVEST 3 AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2018-10-26, registered in Oslo.
It an operating loss of NOK 5,000 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show a strong equity ratio of 99% of total assets.
The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 4.69M, 2024: NOK 4.71M, 2025: NOK 4.24M).
SSS INVEST 3 AS is led by board chair Odd-Erik Bunde.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2018-12-19.
